title: Builder for a Database Configuration
instructions: Implement the nested `DatabaseBuilder` and `DatabaseConfiguration.builder()` in `config/db_config.py`. Each `with_*` setter stores its value and returns the builder so calls chain; `build()` returns the configured `DatabaseConfiguration`, an object that later setter calls on the builder must not change. The `Builder` interface in `config/builder.py` is provided.

evidence.label: builder() returns a fresh builder on every call
Every with_* setter returns the builder so calls chain
Each setter stores its value in the matching field
build() with nothing set returns a configuration of all None
Fields that were never set stay None
A full chain builds the expected configuration
Calling a setter twice keeps the last value
Two builders do not share state
A built object is not changed by later builder calls
